title: Story premise ENT061: The Missing Circle Is a Hole
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (perception and hidden objects). Hook: We found every object. Where is the circle? Takeaway/theme: Look at the spaces between objects as well as the objects.
description: A museum guard must find the circle stolen from a three-shape display, but every search focuses on loose objects. Turning on a lamp reveals that the circle is the empty hole between two curved display pieces; the guard hangs the FOUND label around the gap.
